narrative: Black letter by the door. The title, and no man's name under it. The flag is the one already seen from the walk. A man in a lion's skin comes through a door and is taller than the door. The voice fills the house. The right-hand post is at the edge of the view.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill and stayed by the right-hand post.

entities.name: Edward Alleyn
entities.context: Came through the door in the lion's skin. He did not speak to the yard.

entities.name: the first part of Hercules
entities.context: Shown on stage in A labour
